heading: FAX. No
subheading: DEFINITIONS
description: The definitions given in AIS 008 and AIS 009 shall be applicable to this standard also. The additional terms are defined below. - 3.3. ' Retro-Reflecting Device, also called Retro-Reflector ' means an assembly ready for use and comprising one or more retro-reflecting optical units.

heading: FAX. No
description: ' Retro-Reflection ' means the reflection in which light is reflected in directions close to the direction from which it came. This property is maintained over wide variations of the illumination angle.

heading: FAX. No
description: ' Retro-Reflecting Optical Unit ' means a combination of optical components producing retro-reflection.

heading: FAX. No
description: ' Illuminating Surface of a Retro-Reflecting Device ,' also called ' light emitting surface ' means the total visible surface of the retro-reflecting optical units, which appears continuous at the normal observation distances.

heading: FAX. No
description: ' Axis of Reference ' means the axis to be defined by he manufacturer of the retro-reflecting device, which serves as reference line for the illumination angles in photometric measurements and in practical use. The axis of reference usually corresponds to the axis of symmetry, if any, of the illuminating surface.

heading: FAX. No
description: ' Centre of Reference ' means the intersection of the axis of reference with illuminating surface. It is specified by the manufacturer of the retro-reflecting devices.

heading: FAX. No
description: ' Angle of Divergence ' means the angle between the straight lines connecting the centre of reference to the centre of the receiver and to the centre of the source of illumination.

heading: FAX. No
description: ' Illumination Angle ' means the angle between the axis of reference and the straight line connecting the centre of reference to the centre of the source of illumination.

heading: FAX. No
description: ' Angle of Rotation ' means the angle through which the retro-reflecting device is rotated about its axis of reference starting from one given position.

heading: FAX. No
description: ' Angular Diameter of the Retro-Reflecting Device ' means the angle subtended by the greatest dimension of the visible area of the illuminating surface, either at the centre of the source of illumination or at the centre of the receiver.

heading: FAX. No
description: ' Illumination of the Retro-Reflecting Device ' is the abbreviated expression used conventionally to designate the illumination measured in a plane perpendicular to the incident rays and passing through the centre of reference.

heading: FAX. No
description: ' Coefficient of Luminous Intensity (CIL) ' means the quotient of the luminous intensity reflected in the direction considered, divided by the illumination of the retro-reflecting device for given angles of illumination, divergence and rotation.

heading: FAX. No
subheading: The symbols and units used in this standard are given in Annex A
description: The symbols and units used in this standard are given in Annex A.

heading: FAX. No
description: A type of ' Retro-Reflecting Device ' is defined by the models and descriptive literature submitted with the application for approval. Retro-reflecting devices can be considered as belonging to the same type if they have one or more 'retroreflecting optical units' which are identical with those of the standard model, or if not identical are symmetrical and suitable for mounting one on the left and one on the right side of the vehicle, and if their other parts differ from those of the standard model only in ways not affecting the properties to which this standard applies.

heading: FAX. No
description: 1 = Retro-reflecting devices are divided into three classes according to their photometric characteristics: Class I A or Class I B, Class III A and Class IV A. (See Tables 1 and 2 ). 3.16, 1 = 'Retro-reflecting devices of Class IB ' are devices combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight according to 9.1 and which are integrated into the body of a vehicle.. 4.0, 1 = GENERAL SPCIFICATIONS. 4.1., 1 = Retro-reflecting devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use. In addition, they shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.. 4.2., 1 = The components of retro-reflecting devices shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.. 4.3., 1 = Retro-reflecting optical units may not be replaceable.. 4.4., 1 = The outer surface of retro-reflecting devices shall be easy to clean. Hence it shall not be a rough surface; any protuberances it may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.. 4.5., 1 = For devices of Class IV A, their means of fixation shall be such that they allow a stable and durable connection between the device and the vehicle.. 4.6, 1 = There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.. 4.7, 1 = Requirements of 4.1 , 4.4 and 4.6 are deemed to be satisfied, if the device passes the relevant tests as prescribed in this standard.. 5.0, 1 = SPECIAL SPECIFICATIONS (TESTS). 5.1, 1 = The retro-reflecting devices shall satisfy the following requirements:. 5.1.1, 1 = Shape and dimensions Refer 6. 5.1.2, 1 = Photometric requirements Refer 7. 5.1.3, 1 = Colourimetric requirements Refer 8. 5.1.4, 1 = Resistance to water and dirt penetration Refer 9. 5.1.5, 1 = Resistance to corrosion Refer 10. 5.1.6, 1 = Resistance to fuels Refer 11. 5.1.7, 1 = Resistance to lubricating oils Refer 12. 5.1.8, 1 = Resistance of the accessible rear face of mirror-backed retro-reflecting devices Refer 13. 5.1.9, 1 = Resistance to heat Refer 14. 5.1.10, 1 = Resistance to impact (applicable only for Class IVA) Refer 15. 5.1.11, 1 = Additional tests:Tests for vibration, cold and damp heat. heading: SECTION 7
description: When the CIL of a retro-reflecting device is measured for an angle β of V = H = 0°, it shall be ascertained whether any mirror effect is produced by slightly turning the device. If there is any such effect, a reading shall be taken with an angle β of V = ± 5°, H = 0°. The position adopted shall be that corresponding to the minimum CIL for one of these positions.

heading: SECTION 7
description: With an illumination angle β of V = H = 0°, or the angle specified in 7.5 , and an angle of divergence of 20', retro -reflecting devices which are not marked 'TOP' shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum CIL, which shall conform to the value specified in 7.3 and 7.4 . When the CIL is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retroreflecting device shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε . If the specified values are not attained, the device may be rotated about its axis of reference ± 5° from that position

heading: SECTION 7
description: With an illumination angle β of V = H = 0 0 or the angle specified in 7.5 , and an angle of divergence of 20', retro -reflecting devices marked 'TOP' shall be rotated about their axes ± 5°. The CIL shall not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.

heading: SECTION 7
description: If for the direction V = H = 0°, and for ε = 0° the CIL exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0° .

heading: SECTION 7

heading: SECTION 9
subheading: Water Submersion Test
description: Retro-reflecting devices whether part of a lamp or not, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 O + 5 O C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water. This test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflecting device through 180 O , so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water. These optical units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25° + 5° C.

heading: SECTION 9
subheading: Water Submersion Test
description: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit. If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.

heading: SECTION 9
subheading: Water Submersion Test
description: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, the CIL shall be measured by the method described in 7.9 the retro-reflecting device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.

heading: SECTION 9
subheading: Alternative test procedure for Class IB devices
description: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the tests described in Annex B (moisture and dust test) shall be applied instead of the submersion-test specified in 9.1 .

heading: to 55 Hz
description: 10 Drawings, in triplicate, in sufficient detail to permit identification of the type, showing geometrically the orientation in which the retro-reflecting device is to be fitted to the vehicle. The drawings shall show the position intended for the approval number and class indicator in relation to the approval mark;

heading: to 55 Hz
description: Retro-reflecting devices shall be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed. The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.

heading: to 55 Hz
description: The retro-reflecting device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.

heading: to 55 Hz
description: The saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at a temperature of 35° ± 2 ° C, a saline solution obtained by dissolving 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent of impurities.

heading: to 55 Hz
subheading: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device
description: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.

heading: SECTION 11
description: 11 Colour:

heading: SECTION 11
description: The outer surface of the retro-reflecting device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a mixture of 70% by volume of n-heptane and 30% by volume of toluol.

heading: SECTION 11
description: After about five minutes, the surface shall be inspected visually. It shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks shall not be objected to.

heading: SECTION 12
description: 12 Class of Retro-Reflector

heading: SECTION 12
description: The outer surface of the retro-reflecting device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil. After about 5 minutes, the surface shall be cleaned.

heading: SECTION 12
subheading: The CIL shall then be measured as per 7.9
description: The CIL shall then be measured as per 7.9 .

heading: SECTION 13
description: 13 Effective area of retro-reflector for photometric measurement

heading: SECTION 13
description: After having brushed the rear face of the retro-reflecting device with a hard nylon brush, a cotton cloth soaked in the mixture, defined in 11.1 shall be applied to the said rear face for one minute. The cotton cloth is then removed and the retro-reflecting device left to dry.

heading: SECTION 13
subheading: As soon as evaporation is completed, an abrasion test shall be made by brushing the rear face with the same nylon brush as before
description: As soon as evaporation is completed, an abrasion test shall be made by brushing the rear face with the same nylon brush as before.

heading: SECTION 13
subheading: The CIL shall then be measured (see 7.9 ) after the whole surface of the mirrorbacked rear face has been covered with Indian ink (black)
description: The CIL shall then be measured (see 7.9 ) after the whole surface of the mirrorbacked rear face has been covered with Indian ink (black).

heading: SECTION 14
subheading: The retro-reflecting device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 ± 2 ° C
description: The retro-reflecting device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 ± 2 ° C.

heading: SECTION 14
subheading: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflecting device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible
description: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflecting device and, in particular, of its optical component shall be visible.

heading: SECTION 15
subheading: The retro-reflecting device shall be mounted in a manner similar to the way in which it is mounted on the vehicle, but with the lens faced horizontal and directed upwards
description: The retro-reflecting device shall be mounted in a manner similar to the way in which it is mounted on the vehicle, but with the lens faced horizontal and directed upwards.

heading: SECTION 15
description: Drop a 13 mm diameter polished solid steel ball, once, vertically onto the central part of the lens from a height of 0.76 m. The ball may be guided but not restricted in free fall.

heading: SECTION 15
subheading: When a retro-reflecting device is tested at room temperature with this method, the lens shall not crack
description: When a retro-reflecting device is tested at room temperature with this method, the lens shall not crack.

heading: SECTION 16
description: The applicant shall submit for approval ten samples, which shall be tested in the chronological order indicated in Annex C. Actual sequence of testing is applicable only for the tests carried out on the same sample.

heading: SECTION 16
subheading: Tests on all the samples
description: Tests on all the samples

heading: SECTION 16
subheading: Tests on all the samples
description: All the ten samples shall be subjected to verification of general specifications ( See 4.0) of shape and dimensions ( See 6.0) and visual inspection of colorimetry ( See 8.0). In case of a doubt on compliance to colorimetry, the most doubtful sample shall - be subjected to measurement of trichromatic coordinates.

heading: SECTION 16
subheading: Tests on all the samples
description: Then the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test ( see 14.0). At least one hour after this test, the samples shall be visually examined for cracks and deformation and colorimetric characteristics (See 8.4.1 ).

heading: SECTION 16
subheading: Limited photometry shall be carried out on all the ten samples ( see 7.9 )
description: Limited photometry shall be carried out on all the ten samples ( see 7.9 ).

heading: SECTION 16
description: The two retro-reflecting devices, which have the minimum and maximum values of test results as per 16.2.3 , shall then be fully tested as shown in 7 . 0 - These two samples shall be kept by the test agencies for any further checks, which may be found necessary.

heading: SECTION 16
subheading: The other eight samples shall be divided into four groups of two samples each, the tests for each group shall be carried out as described below
description: The other eight samples shall be divided into four groups of two samples each, the tests for each group shall be carried out as described below:

heading: SECTION 16
subheading: First group
description: The two samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test ( see 9.1 ) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels ( see 11.0 )and lubricating oils ( see 12.0 ).

heading: SECTION 16
subheading: In the case of retro reflecting devices of Class IB, the alternate test as per Annex B may be carried out
description: In the case of retro reflecting devices of Class IB, the alternate test as per Annex B may be carried out.

heading: SECTION 16
subheading: Second group
description: The two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test ( see 10.0 ) and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflecting device ( see 13.0 ).

heading: SECTION 16
subheading: In case of retro - reflecting devices of class IVA, these two samples shall also be subjected to impact test ( see 15.0 )
description: In case of retro - reflecting devices of class IVA, these two samples shall also be subjected to impact test ( see 15.0 )

heading: SECTION 16
subheading: Third group
description: The two samples shall be subjected to vibration test ( F1 of Annex F ).

heading: SECTION 16
subheading: Fourth group
description: The two samples shall be subjected to exposure to damp heat (Cycling) test ( F3 of Annex F ) and cold temperature test ( F2 of Annex F ).

heading: SECTION 16
subheading: After undergoing the tests referred to in the above paragraph, the retro-reflecting devices in each group shall have
description: After undergoing the tests referred to in the above paragraph, the retro-reflecting devices in each group shall have:

heading: SECTION 16
subheading: A colour, which satisfies the conditions, laid down in 8 . This shall be verified by a qualitative method and, in case of doubt, confirmed by a quantitative method
description: A colour, which satisfies the conditions, laid down in 8 . This shall be verified by a qualitative method and, in case of doubt, confirmed by a quantitative method.

heading: SECTION 16
subheading: A CIL, which satisfies the conditions, laid down in 7.9
description: A CIL, which satisfies the conditions, laid down in 7.9.

heading: SECTION 17
description: At the time of application, the manufacturer shall declare to the test agency the information given in Table 4 and applicable number of samples of the retroreflecting device if necessary, the means of fixation.

heading: SECTION 17
subheading: If the samples submitted meet the requirements of this standard, approval shall be granted
description: If the samples submitted meet the requirements of this standard, approval shall be granted. When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps (including a retro-reflector), approval is granted only if each of these lamps satisfies the requirements of the corresponding standards. Lamps not satisfying any one of those standards shall not be part of such a unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.

heading: SECTION 17
description: At the choice of the manufacturer, it will specify that the device may be installed on the vehicle with different inclinations of the reference axis in respect to the vehicle reference planes and to the ground or, in case of Class IA, IB and IVA retro-reflectors, rotate around its reference axis; these different conditions of installation shall be indicated in the information.

heading: SECTION 18
subheading: CHANGES IN TECHNICAL SPECIFICATION
description: If the changes are in parameters not related to the provisions, no further action need be taken. If the changes are in parameters related to the provisions, the Testing Agency, which has issued the test report of compliance, may then consider, whether,

heading: SECTION 18
description: Every modification pertaining to the information, even if the changes are not technical in nature declared in accordance with 17.1 shall be intimated by the manufacturer to the test agency.

heading: SECTION 18
subheading: the retro-reflecting device with the changed specifications still complies with provisions; or,
description: the retro-reflecting device with the changed specifications still complies with provisions; or,

heading: SECTION 18
subheading: any further verification is required to establish compliance
description: any further verification is required to establish compliance.

heading: SECTION 18
subheading: For considering whether testing is required or not, guidelines given in 19.0 (Criteria for Extension of Approval) shall be used
description: For considering whether testing is required or not, guidelines given in 19.0 (Criteria for Extension of Approval) shall be used.

heading: SECTION 18
subheading: In case of 18.1.2, tests for only those parameters which are affected by the modifications need be carried out
description: In case of 18.1.2, tests for only those parameters which are affected by the modifications need be carried out

heading: SECTION 18
description: In case of fulfillment of criterion as per 18.1.1 or after results of further verification as per 18.1.2 are satisfactory, the approval of compliance shall be extended for the changes carried out.

heading: SECTION 19
subheading: CRITERIA FOR EXTENSION OF APPROVAL
description: This condition is not applicable to devices of Class IV A.

heading: SECTION 19
description: If the approval granted in respect of a retro-reflecting device is extended to other such devices differing only in colour, the two samples in any other colour submitted shall be required to meet only the colorimetric and photometric specifications, the other tests no longer being required.

heading: SECTION 19
subheading: Till the details are finalized, the Criteria shall be as agreed between the test agency and manufacturer
description: Till the details are finalized, the Criteria shall be as agreed between the test agency and manufacturer.

heading: SECTION 20
subheading: REQUIREMENTS OF CONFORMITY OF PRODUCTION
description: Note: The provision of 20.0 will come into force after AIS-037 is notified for implementation.

heading: SECTION 20
description: Devices approved under this standard shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in these standard and relevant annexes.

heading: SECTION 20
description: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this standard.

heading: SECTION 20
description: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced retro-reflectors shall not be contested if, when testing photometric performances of any retro-reflector chosen at random no measured value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the minimum values prescribed in this Standard.

heading: SECTION 20
subheading: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with
description: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with.

heading: SECTION 20
subheading: The details of the minimum checks to be carried out by manufacturer are detailed in Annex D
description: The details of the minimum checks to be carried out by manufacturer are detailed in Annex D .

heading: SECTION 20
subheading: The test agency may at any time verify the conformity control methods applied in each production facility
description: The test agency may at any time verify the conformity control methods applied in each production facility.

heading: SECTION 20
subheading: The normal frequency of these verifications shall be as decided by CMVR-TSC
description: The normal frequency of these verifications shall be as decided by CMVR-TSC.

heading: SECTION 20
subheading: Retro-reflectors with apparent defects are ignored
description: Retro-reflectors with apparent defects are ignored.

heading: SECTION 20
subheading: The statistical criterion for verifying compliance to the photometric requirements is given in Annex E
description: The statistical criterion for verifying compliance to the photometric requirements is given in Annex E .

heading: SECTION 21
subheading: Every retro-reflecting device shall bear the following markings
description: Every retro-reflecting device shall bear the following markings

heading: SECTION 21
subheading: Every retro-reflecting device shall bear the following markings
description: the word 'TOP' inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer

heading: SECTION 21
subheading: A space of sufficient size to accommodate the approval mark shall be provided on every device. (As per AIS 037)
description: A space of sufficient size to accommodate the approval mark shall be provided on every device. (As per AIS 037)

heading: SECTION 21
subheading: Symbols IA, IB, IIIA or IVA showing the class of the retro-reflecting device
description: Symbols IA, IB, IIIA or IVA showing the class of the retro-reflecting device. - 21.1.3 the trade name or mark of the applicant;

heading: SECTION 21
description: The marking of the word 'TOP', the approval mark (as and when AIS -037 becomes mandatory for retro-reflecting devices) and group symbol markings shall be clearly legible and be indelible. They shall be applied on the illuminating surface, or on one of the illuminating surfaces, of the retroreflecting device and shall be visible from the outside when the retro-reflecting device is fitted on the vehicle.

heading: SECTION 21
description: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps comply with the requirements covered by different standards, a single approval mark may be applied, an approval number and, if necessary, the required arrow. This approval mark may be placed anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps provided that:

heading: SECTION 21
subheading: It is visible after their installation;
description: It is visible after their installation;

heading: SECTION 21
subheading: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark
description: No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light can be removed without at the same time removing the approval mark.

heading: SECTION 21
subheading: On the prototype for type approval the marking may be provided by suitable temporary methods and need not necessary be obtained from the tools used for series production
description: On the prototype for type approval the marking may be provided by suitable temporary methods and need not necessary be obtained from the tools used for series production.
